description: This file implements URL handling functionalities including parsing, encoding, decoding, and base64 encoding/decoding within the WPEFramework project. It defines URL schemes, parsing logic to decompose URLs into components, and methods for URL encoding/decoding.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: Class representing a URL, including its components like scheme, host, path, query, etc., with methods to parse and generate URL strings.

methods.name: URL::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a string into URL-encoded format.

methods.name: URL::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string back to its original form.

methods.name: URL::Base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into base64 string.

methods.name: URL::Base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string into binary data.

methods.name: URL::Parse
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its components.

methods.name: URL::ParseDomain
methods.description: Parses the domain part of a URL, extracting host and port.

methods.name: URL::Text
methods.description: Constructs the URL string from the decomposed components.

uint16_t Encode(const TCHAR * source,const uint16_t sourceLength,TCHAR * destination,const uint16_t destinationLength)
uint32_t FindNext(const TextFragment & url,const uint32_t start,const uint32_t end)
